description: Harvest is a time-tracking and invoicing product with a v2 REST-style API and Forecast API.
auth_notes: V2 requires an access token; a Personal Access Token tied to the user is the quickest option. A second option is truncated in the sources.
gate_detail: Personal Access Tokens can be generated through a Harvest ID account. Plan requirements are not stated and no sandbox is described.
api_scope: Resources include clients, invoices, estimates, expenses, tasks, time entries, projects, users, reports, approvals, time off, imports, notifications and the Forecast API.
mcp_notes: Sources show no Harvest time-tracking MCP server; the Greenhouse Harvest source is a different product.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate appears in the sources, though plan requirements are not stated.

evidence.quote: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests. There are two options available to you:
A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing aro
By using PATs, which you can easily generate via your Harvest ID account
Welcome to the Harvest API v2 Help Center

uncertainties: Second auth option (likely OAuth2) is cut off in the source.
Free plan versus paid plan requirement is not stated.
Webhooks, sandbox and MCP are not covered.
S4 (Greenhouse Harvest) and S5 (harvest.com site monitoring) are different products and were ignored.
